Refine ONLY the small inserted Lamar Jackson behind the woman wearing the black knit hat, in the background left of the large yellow sign. His face is currently too crisp, frontal, and posed. Preserve his exact position, current head size, connected Ravens fan hoodie and body, but turn his head slightly toward the action at image right, with a relaxed candid expression. Keep recognizable Lamar Jackson facial structure and braids while matching the distinctly SOFT, OUT-OF-FOCUS heads beside him on the same row. Hair and skin detail must have the same optical softness as the neighboring background fans. No bright studio facial lighting; match the dim local shade. Output only the clean edited photograph.
